free_tier.stated: No upper limit. Base 3 TB included from EUR 15/mo; EUR 3.50 per additional TB.

interface_detail: S3-compatible (SigV4). Endpoint probed live: https://s3.eu-amsterdam-1.megas4.com/ returns HTTP 400 with {Code:InvalidRequest, Message:'Please use AWS Signature Version 4 for authentication'} — a real, correctly-implemented S3 endpoint, not a marketing page.
tooling: rclone (first-party guide), AWS CLI, Synology Hyper Backup, TrueNAS, Duplicacy, MSP360, Cyberduck, Terraform
chaining: Native S3 -> any S3 client; first-party Cloudflare CDN guide documented at help.mega.io/megas4/setup-guides/cloudflare-setup-guide-for-mega-s4
limits_note: None on object size published. Egress beyond 5x stored is metered and charged.
reliability_note: MEGA has run since 2013; S4 is a newer product line (2025) so the durability record on S4 itself is short. Brand-level: no mass data-loss event. Note the 2013 MEGA breach was credential/architecture, not storage loss.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'EUR 3.50 per TB a month on our pay-as-you-grow plan, with 3 TB included from EUR 15. 5x free egress, no API charges and no minimum storage period.'
'MEGA S4 allows up to 5x of the average monthly stored data as free egress'
